text: player
Trust Is Lost in an Instant
Kotaro Katsura
He only made his move after seeing what you threw.
Gintoki's fought tooth and nail on the battlefield. For him, reading you is merely child's play.
Don't be fooled by those dead fish eyes now. No matter how down-and-out he looks, he was once the fearsome White Knight.
Gintoki Sakata
Oi, who's down-and-out? Cut the bull!
Not Oi, it's Katsura!
Ichihime
Nyaa? Didn't expect Gin to be such a big deal, nyaa!
Guess everyone has their own story.
Tatsuma Sakamoto
Enough of that! Kintoki! So you did throw after me, didn't you?! That's so cheap! Weren't we supposed to settle this fair and square?!
Again, it's Gintoki, not Kintoki. Besides, it's not my fault you didn't notice.
Cut the excuses! This is all your fault – my customers are all gone!
Perfect. Then there's no more business for you here. Time to head back now.
NOT PERFECT AT ALL!!!
Hey! Lower your voice!
We are not even in our world, and you two are still bickering? Can't you two just give it a rest?
You're the last person who should be saying that.
Wait, Cobra, what are you doing here anyway?
Dojo?
Is it for teaching swordsmanship, nyaa? Or mahjong, nyaa?
Neither. I'm teaching the people of this city how to rectify the world's ways.
Rectify what? You don't even know about this place.
Well... Master, any idea, nyaa?
Hmm...
I don't really know.
There's no such thing.
No clue... but perhaps Mr. Katsura sees what we don't.
I don't think anything's missing in One Han City.
Is that truly the case? Now, listen carefully –
Eliisa
Uno!
Somewhere in One Han City
Hana Ninomiya
Don't even think about it, +4!
The one thing this city's missing is... Uno!
Uno?! But why?!!!
But Mahjong Soul is a mahjong app!!!
Once Uno gets popular, it might turn into an Uno app.
Stop daydreaming!
Mr. Katsura is... actually planning to revolutionize Mahjong Soul, nyaa...
That's some peculiar way of thinking... As expected of the Scoundrel Three...
Keep this nonsense up, and the Mahjong Soul devs yeet you straight out of the code! Hurry up and get back to our own world already!
Get back?
Are you going back, Mr. Katsura?
There's still so much I haven't learned from you...!
Please don't go, Mr. Katsura!
Mr. Katsura!
You guys...!
Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere!//nI'll keep preaching the way of Uno right here in this city!
Eliisa & Hana Ninomiya
Mr. Katsura!!
Oi, that's enough! Cut out the weird high school drama already!
As you can see, so long as even a single student remains here who needs my guidance, I will not return.
That's not up to you. If we leave you here, we might even lose the Gintama collaboration.
Tell you what – fight me. If I win, you do as I say. How's that?
Hmph, fine. But I'm choosing the game. If we're competing... then it's gotta be Uno!
Deal. Perfect chance to see what this Dojo Master is really made of.
Take this, Gintoki! +2!
Then I'll +2 as well.
Well... Not bad...!
Next up... Uno! How about that, huh? One more card and I win.
Hmph, don't get cocky just because you're down to one card. It's not over yet. Yellow 5!
There, Blue 5. And I win again.
Wh-what?! How is that possible?!!!
That makes ten wins in a row for Gin.
Mr. Katsura is... a little too easy to beat, isn't he, nyaa?
We... we're not done yet! I'm not giving up! As long as my students are still rooting for me, I won't be defeated here...!
Wait... where are Lady Ninomiya and Lady Eliisa?
They've already gone home.
Mr. Katsura has been abandoned, nyaa.
Traitors!!!
It looks like Mr. Sakamoto and Mr. Katsura have made it back to their own world safely, nyaa.
That leaves only one of the Scoundrel Three.
Who will it be, nyaa?
Ah... I have a feeling. It's someone a hundred times more of a headache than those two put together.

Not Cobra, it's Katsura. No idea what happened. One minute I was minding my own business, the next I was here in One Han City. And after a whole bunch of twists and turns, I'm now running a dojo here.
Precisely because I'm an outsider, I see what the locals can't. Something is missing in this city – do you know what that is?
You're giving him way too much credit. They say there's only a thin line between a genius and an idiot – he's clearly on the idiot side.
This, is my answer –
Mahjong is practically dominating One Han City. If Uno can catch on here, it'll prove its greatness. That's why I've opened an Uno dojo in this city!
